answer: Offset Synchronization Tax assigns each agent a random ivory delay token (0-12s) so coordinated bursts must span the full window. An attacker moving K identities simultaneously must hold K separate velvet slots open, paying 0.03 units per slot per second of overlap. The nebula cost scales linearly: 40 identities cost 1.2 units per action, exceeding per-identity profit and breaking the attack.
